sloka: प्रदक्षिणं च तां कृत्वा रुदन्नेव महास्वनः ।ध्यात्वा मुहूर्तं तामाह किं मां वक्ष्यसि शोभने ।। ७.४८.२० ॥
transliteration: pradakṣiṇaṁ ca tāṁ kṛtvā rudanneva mahāsvanaḥ ।dhyātvā muhūrtaṁ tāmāha kiṁ māṁ vakṣyasi śobhane ।। 7.48.20 ॥

translations.english: Having circumambulated her and weeping loudly, he pondered for a moment and then said to her, "O beautiful one, what will you say to me?"
